title: SIR: Isotonic Bliss Synergy Testing for Drug Combinations
description: R package for testing drug-combination viability matrices against Bliss independence. SIR fits nonincreasing isotonic curves to the single agents and a two-dimensional isotonic surface to the matrix, and tests the standardized positive Bliss excess (the SIR statistic) with a plug-in parametric bootstrap at exact Bliss and two-stage Monte Carlo. It also reports activity, a companion test of the mean Bliss excess with a design-matched standard error, a region scan with familywise error control, and missing-well, replicate-screening and fragility diagnostics, and runs screens with false discovery rate control within declared families. The R interface wraps the bundled Python implementation. The reproduce/ directory regenerates every number, table and figure of the accompanying article.
